# apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member (Resource)

Adds a leaderboard to a Game Center leaderboard set of the same app or group. Import it with `<leaderboard_set_id>/<leaderboard_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member" "weekly" {
  leaderboard_set_id = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set.seasons.id
  leaderboard_id     = apple_game_center_leaderboard.weekly.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard, e.g. `apple_game_center_leaderboard.example.id`.
- `leaderboard_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard set, e.g. `apple_game_center_leaderboard_set.example.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member.weekly
  identity = {
    leaderboard_set_id = "6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f"
    leaderboard_id     = "4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `leaderboard_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard.
- `leaderboard_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard set.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member.weekly 6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f/4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c
```
